explanation: The sole Item binds the far endpoint across two independently sized ellipses. Red variants run before Blue, and each source visits the first gap before the second: the nearest Relay is tried before a later Relay, with its nearest eligible Target first. A successful tuple clears its source, changes its middle Relay to Spent and fills its endpoint; live rechecks must reject every stale tuple that reuses any of those changed cells. In rbkttkttP, Red uses relay x2 and target x3; Blue must skip the spent first relay and use relay x5 and target x6, leaving targets x4 and x7 empty. With only one relay, Blue remains at its Origin even though unfilled targets remain. The last level gives Red gaps (3, 1) and Blue gaps (4, 0), checking unequal and empty second gaps while preserving their different inferred identities. Transferred members have no Origin, and Spent is outside the Relay predicate, so subsequent inputs cannot relaunch the transfers.
